description: This Java class 'ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric' monitors and calculates the quality metric for closed loop control systems by tracking recent error measurements, computing their standard deviation, and updating sensor values periodically.

classes.name: ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric
classes.description: A class that measures and updates a quality metric for closed-loop control by tracking errors, computing standard deviation, and updating sensor data periodically.

methods.name: ClosedLoopControlQualityMetric
methods.description: Constructor initializing target and result value sources, and sensor destination.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts periodic measurement and update of the control quality metric.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates and returns the standard deviation of errors.

methods.name: rememberCurrentError
methods.description: Records the current error into the buffer.
